images.alt:
A lone ballerina en pointe at the center of an abandoned warehouse, pirouetting through a rupture in reality. From her outstretched fingertips, ribbons of liquid color cascade—Impressionist lilacs, Fauvist vermilions, Cubist fractured geometrics of yellow and black—splattering across crumbling concrete walls and pooling on the floor like a flooded paint factory. Her tutu dissolves into pure pigment at the hem. Drips of color defy gravity, crawling upward. A shattered mirror behind her multiplies the explosion into infinity.
Style: Surrealism meets Abstract Expressionism; Degas-inspired figure painting with Pollock-esque splatter
Composition: Symmetrical frontal staging with the dancer as the fulcrum; leading lines of color ribbons radiating outward like a chromatic sunburst
Lighting: Single overhead theatrical spotlight, cold and clinical, contrasting with the warm explosive color; strong chiaroscuro
Adjectives: Ethereal, violent, dreamlike, kinetic, transcendent
